name: Higuchi Kazuto
source:
A beautician.
Star Sign: Cancer
Hobby: Watching DVD's
Likes: Sake and Snacks
Dislikes: Tall Places, Bitter Melon

An old friend of Kai's from high school. They're still friendly now.
A calm and gentle guy, who contrary to his looks is a bit of an airhead.
After graduating from a technical school he was hired at a famous hair salon, he's working hard to become a top stylist.
